analysis_status: exploratory fixed local protocol; not public preregistration
research_question: On exactly the Q4 four-class trials and nine-subject LOSO splits, how does source-only EEGNet compare with broad CSP8 plus LDA?
hypothesis: EEGNet may learn transferable temporal-spatial structure, but superiority is not assumed.

training.epoch_selection: earliest epoch minimizing equal-inner-fold mean validation CE

evaluation.target_information: No target-subject fit, normalization, early stopping, seed choice, or hyperparameter tuning
evaluation.primary_population: all trials including expert artifact flags
evaluation.primary_metric: subject-level balanced_accuracy, then equal-subject mean of three-seed means
evaluation.inference: descriptive paired subject contrasts; no 27-independent-observation test

resource_benchmark.note: Synthetic shape-matched CPU benchmark only, not EEG classification or model selection.

limitations: BNCI data and Q4 comparator were previously explored; this is not an independent confirmatory study.
Forty-epoch cap is compute-bounded; a selected boundary epoch indicates possible undertraining.
Offline zero-phase run filtering is not a causal online pipeline.
Braindecode EEGNet here is not the original paper's exact preprocessing or split reproduction.
